title: Two consecutive lines are both tagged 'Lys:' where the second reads like it's answering on someone else's behalf ('Both of them. He asked it of you, so I'll keep what I'd have said otherwise. He's counted wolves longer than I have...') — unclear who 'he' is or why one speaker tag covers what feels like two different voices.
where: Wolf Scrape, talking with Lys ('ask why she's gone quiet')
